mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over the Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 60 degrees and a first quarter moon. If you are an early riser, keep an eye out for the I S S at 4:09 AM as it streaks from the south southwest near Belleville toward the east northeast by Fitchburg and Madison.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes water and sewer updates, as well as new pavement and sidewalks for Mark Drive, Rita Avenue, and Plympton Street.

There is plenty happening today, including the Epic Systems User Group Meeting, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and a live concert at Century School Park. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard tomorrow.
In a report from Friday, August 15, Verona police arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I after she was found asleep behind the wheel and attempted to drive away when officers intervened.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently closed but will open its doors to serve you starting at 10 AM.
